video_title: Do the Jays have beef? + Can Miami and Bam rebound from a disappointing start? | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Bam Adebayo's role in the Miami Heat's defensive struggles
quotes.excerpt: It hinges on the entire team because offense takes a while to come, but defense should always be here.
quotes.quote: It hinges on the entire team because offense takes a while to come, but defense should always be here. Everyone on the Miami Heat can get this smoke because they are giving up 132 points per possession, which is literally the worst in the NBA. If we are talking about Heat culture, it starts on that end of the floor. It is everyone and it is not just Bam Adebayo. Bam will come along.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Miami Heat's roster depth issues and reliance on Bam Adebayo
quotes.excerpt: The problem with the Heat is the roster is too deep. I mean they've got two players.
quotes.quote: The problem with the Heat is one, Bam Adebayo, he's part of it. Why is Bam Adebayo just a jump shooter these days? But the problem with the Heat is the roster is too deep. I don't mean starters and bench, I mean they've got two players on the roster. They need a few transaction cycles to fill this thing out. They've got some fire hydrants on the perimeter defensively. It's not all on Bam.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Houston Rockets' offensive potential with Fred VanVleet and Alperen Sengun
quotes.excerpt: It's not just Alperen Sengun leading them in scoring at 24 points per game, he's averaging seven assists.
quotes.quote: It's not just Alperen Sengun leading them in scoring at 24 points per game, he's averaging seven assists. It's not just Kevin Durant making it easy with four straight 20-point games. It's not just Amen Thompson averaging 17 alongside Jabari Smith Jr. It's the fact that Fred VanVleet is back. Their comfort level is there. He is also averaging seven assists and he's going to shoot the ball better in the future.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Houston Rockets' status as a Western Conference contender
quotes.excerpt: Before Fred VanVleet went down, people thought they were contenders, they are right now.
quotes.quote: Simple fact is the Spurs are now the favorites. On a neutral court, the Rockets beat them. They're undefeated and you're absolutely right about this. Fred VanVleet puts everything in place. Before Fred VanVleet went down, people thought they were contenders, they are right now.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum addresses the alleged beef with Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: It's not about that. It's not about Shaq and Kobe, there's no beef.
quotes.quote: There are many people playing in this league that never went to the finals. We went twice and won a championship, so it should be more about that. It's not about Shaq and Kobe, there's no beef. It's not about that.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown dismisses beef rumors with Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: There's no beef. Jayson comes from a wonderful family. We've accomplished some great things.
quotes.quote: There's no beef. Jayson comes from a wonderful family. We've accomplished some great things. He's a hell of a basketball player. He's got a great PR team. There's no beef, but it might be a little lamb chops and some gravy. You know what I mean? He should stay ready at all times.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon's perspective on the Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown dynamic
quotes.excerpt: We knew that they had their little problematic little relationship, but it wasn't against each other.
quotes.quote: When we talk about the temperature of the NBA, I feel like you need stories like this to keep everything going. We knew that they had their little problematic little relationship, but it wasn't against each other. It was always who can get the good boy thing from Boston, and they picked Jayson Tatum. So I have no problem with the lamb chops. I hope y'all like lamb chops. I want to eat good, I want to see it.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike on the Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown team dynamic
quotes.excerpt: I might be on the side of Jaylen Brown because Jayson Tatum, if you wanted Jaylen Brown there.
quotes.quote: I am from Texas, which means I love me some beef just as much as I do, okay? In this situation, I might be on the side of Jaylen Brown because Jayson Tatum, if you wanted Jaylen Brown there, I think the organization would have absolutely said, 'Hey, I need this guy.' And so, he probably would have stayed. And if you didn't co-sign him leaving, then I just think that the beef is okay to have because it brings out better basketball.
